messages:
Nina: Heads-up: main SAST started failing after the RBAC rollout. Evidence upload fails with KMS decrypt AccessDenied.
Omar: saw that, scanner SA svc-scan@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com returns iam permission denied on decrypt.
InfraBot: alert: sast-run-1291 failed (kms.AccessDenied) https://ci.internal/runs/1291
Priyanka: paste smallest error so infra can triage quickly?
Nina: log snippet:
```
2026-06-14T11:02:03Z ERROR evidence-uploader: decrypt failed: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc="projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/secure-kr/cryptoKeys/evidence: request denied" principal=serviceAccount:svc-scan@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Omar: short-term: re-add roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter binding scoped to the single key. Use PR + annotated audit note.
Priyanka: long-term: two changes: (1) premerge CI check for IAM changes that exercises decrypt with a test key; (2) make SAST pipeline tolerant: on decrypt fail upload redacted artifact to quarantined bucket and mark scan as "partial".
Sam: DAST implications: if SAST artifact is partial, authenticated crawls should fall back to unauthenticated mode and enqueue a re-run once evidence is available. Add to runbook.
Omar: example gcloud command to add binding:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding evidence \
  --keyring=secure-kr --location=global \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scan@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Priyanka: add CI unit that simulates AccessDenied so premerge catches missing SA perms. Also include audit query snippets for Cloud Audit Logs in the playbook.
Nina: I'll open the incident doc and attach audit logs. @Omar can you open the PR to grant the key role and a separate PR for the pipeline fallback prototype?
Omar: opening PRs now, will tag infra/sec for review. ETA today EOD.
InfraBot: incident-created: https://docs.internal/security/incidents/1967004321-sast-evidence-kms-rbac-rollback (auto)
Nina: triage complete for now, tracking follow-ups in the incident doc: PR-role-grant, PR-premerge-test, PR-fallback, playbook update.
